        o.ship_region,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) AS net_revenue
    FROM
        order_items AS oi
    JOIN
        orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE
        o.status IN (3, 4) -- Filter for shipped or delivered orders
    GROUP BY
        o.ship_region
),

    SELECT
        o.ship_region,
        SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS shipping_fee_total
    FROM

        o.ship_region
)

FROM opportunities AS o
JOIN sales_reps AS sr
  ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id

    SELECT
      h.employee_id
    FROM hr_bridge AS h
    JOIN learners AS l
      ON h.work_email = l.email
    JOIN course_completions AS cc
      ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id
    JOIN courses AS c
      ON cc.course_id = c.course_id
    WHERE
      c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation'
  )
